actions.description: Start the pump at the flow rate stored on the device (<n>RUN)
actions.name: start_pump

outputs.description: Signed flow rate read back after the run command
outputs.name: flow_rate

actions.description: Stop this pump and zero its rate (<n>STP, then <n>RAT0UH); it takes no input
actions.name: stop_pump

outputs.description: True once the stop and zero-rate commands were accepted
outputs.name: stopped

adjusts.description: Signed flow-rate set point in uL/hour; the pump keeps its current run or stop state
adjusts.name: flow_rate

adjusts.description: Inner diameter of the mounted syringe in mm; it changes the plunger speed for a flow rate
adjusts.name: diameter

facts.text: The upstream programs control New Era NE-500 OEM one-channel syringe pumps with 1 mL, 3 mL, 5 mL or 10 mL Becton Dickinson syringes
The pump GUI opens the serial chain at 19200 baud with a 0.2 s read timeout
The GUI offers 1, 3, 5 and 10 mL BD syringes with inner diameters 4.699, 8.585, 11.99 and 14.50 mm
Each pump on a chain is named a unique single digit integer 0-9
A chain holds at most 10 pumps, addressed 0-9
Flow rates are entered and displayed in uL/hour
The Prime button sets the flow rate to 10,000 uL/hr and starts the pump
The GUI sends the direction (INF or WDR) before the rate, then writes UH below 5000 and MH at 5000 or above by dividing the rate by 1000
A rate query is sent twice: the fourth byte of the first reply is W for a withdraw, and the second reply carries the value and the UH or MH unit
The syringe diameter is set with <n>DIA<mm> and read with <n>DIA
The broadcast *STP stops all pumps; the per-pump stop sends <n>STP and then <n>RAT0UH
Prime starts one pump with <n>RAT10.0MH and then <n>RUN

operator_required.name: flow_rate
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the flow-rate range of an NE-500; the README gives the 10,000 uL/hour prime rate, which is not a maximum, so the site supplies the range of its pump, syringe and tubing

operator_required.name: diameter
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states a syringe-diameter range; the four BD diameters in the GUI are a menu, not a device bound, so the site supplies the range of the syringes it mounts

safe_state.description: the pump is stopped with <n>STP and its rate is zeroed with <n>RAT0UH
